name: order_bench
description: order_bench evaluates models' ability to determine and recover correct orderings/relative sequences (temporal or logical) from textual inputs. It contains tasks that require reasoning about the order of events or items and selecting or predicting the correct ordering. The benchmark is focused on evaluating ordering/sequence reasoning rather than generic language capabilities.
reputation: A niche dataset on Hugging Face with modest community usage; useful for targeted ordering/temporal reasoning evaluations.
